title: fix(core)!: the value data source refuses a plain-object comparand under a `$` operator, as under the AST operators
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoK8YCcS3hkJHvVLxZNeiKG8)_
Fixes #35493
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or docs page teaches a plain-object comparand under a `$` operator on the value data source; the spec's comparand door already refuses that comparand on every server face, so there is nothing to un-teach

## 维护者速读

1. 用户能看到什么变化：使用内嵌数据（不连服务器）的列表、看板等视图，如果筛选条件把"一个对象"当作比较值（例如"负责人不等于某个对象"），以前会悄悄返回全部或部分记录，现在不返回记录，并在浏览器控制台说明原因；正常的筛选不受影响。
2. 为什么做：收口上一张"按关联字段钻取明细"修复的评审发现——内嵌数据源的一种筛选写法仍然在平台本应拒绝的地方放行数据，和服务器端的行为不一致。
3. 出错会怎样：受影响的只有开发者和预览场景里写错的筛选条件，它们会显示为空列表而不是错误的数据；直接回滚本次改动即可恢复原来的行为。
4. 要你做什么：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ValueDataSource` (`ui/packages/core`, the in-memory `provider: 'value'` source) now refuses a plain-object comparand with no `$` key in its object (`$`) dialect, with the same sentence its AST dialect gives, from one builder.

- **One builder, both arms.** `nestedRelationComparandRefusal` (new, beside `nestedRelationComparandKey` and `nestedRelationRefusalReason`) judges the WHOLE comparand and, for a list operator, each MEMBER. `matchesComparisonNode` (AST arm) and `matchesDollarOperator` (`$` arm) both call it; the `$` arm calls it after the two array guards and before the `{ $field }` resolution, the AST arm's order.
- **Operator set, per operator.** Measured on `b65488a8` before the change, with `{ owner: { OP: { id: 'u1' } } }`:

  | Operator | Before | Now |
  |---|---|---|
  | `$ne`, `$notContains` | every row | refused |
  | `$gt` `$gte` `$lt` `$lte` | the rows sorting past `[object Object]` | refused |
  | `$eq`, `$contains`, `$startsWith`, `$endsWith` | no row, nothing logged | refused |
  | `$in`, `$nin`, `$between` (object as the whole comparand) | no row, nothing logged | refused |
  | `$nin` (object as a list member) | every row | refused |
  | `$in`, `$between` (object as a list member) | no row, nothing logged | refused |
  | `$icontains` | refused by the text comparand door | refused by the nested-relation builder, as the AST arm's `icontains` already was |
  | `$empty` | refused by its boolean-flag arm | unchanged: keeps its own sentence |
  | `$null`, `$exists` | flag read for truthiness | unchanged, not in scope (see Acceptance notes) |
  | keys outside `FILTER_OPERATORS` (`$regex`, `$like`, a non-`$` key) | refused by the `default` arm | unchanged |

  The set is the spec's `FILTER_OPERATORS` minus the three flag operators, the `$` twin of the AST arm's `AST_NO_COMPARAND_OPERATORS` exclusion; a test pins it equal.
- **Class instance (card comment 7012153506).** A class instance given as a field's WHOLE condition, `{ created: someMomentDate }`, is data: `loweringConditionRefusal` (renamed from `zeroKeyConditionRefusal`) now routes an object that is not plain to the converter, as it already routed a zero-key `RegExp` / `Map` / `Set`, so the refusal is the converter's exotic-comparand sentence instead of a nested-relation sentence per own key. The prototype test is the new shared `isPlainObject`, which `nestedRelationComparandKey` now calls too. A class instance under an operator still compares through `valueOf` (ruled).
- **Bounded in-place fix (declared).** The AST arm had the same list-member hole: `['owner', 'nin', [{ id: 'u1' }]]` answered every row. It is the same defect class, in the same file, from the same builder, in the same gate family, so it is fixed here rather than filed; the four conditions of the in-place exemption hold.

**Producer side.** The comparand is authored data (a `$filter` handed to `find`); the spec's comparand door `normalizeFilterComparandTypes` already refuses it on the server path, so this is the consumer face failing open where the contract refuses, not a consumer tolerance. No spec or converter change.

### Compile surfaces (filter semantics)

Each face was checked for a plain-object comparand under a `$` operator. The server faces all sit behind the spec's comparand door, cited by symbol (no line addresses, per `ui/AGENTS.md` #11):

| Face | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 driver-sql `applyFilterCondition` (sqlite-wasm, turso local inherit) | already compliant | every `where` passes the engine's door first: `lowerWhereFilterArray` in `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts` calls `normalizeFilterComparandTypes` on the object form, and `parseFilterAST` runs the same walk on the array form |
| 2 driver-turso RemoteTransport `buildWhereSQL` | already compliant | same engine door (`lowerWhereFilterArray`) |
| 3 service-analytics `compileScopedFilterToSql` | already compliant | `read-scope-sql.ts` calls `normalizeFilterComparandTypes(scope, undefined, 'readScope')` |
| 4 service-analytics `lowerAnalyticsWhere` | already compliant | `filter-normalizer.ts` `normalizeWhereComparandTypes` hands every field entry to `normalizeFilterComparandTypes` |
| 5 formula `matchesFilterCondition` | already compliant | measured on the built package: `$ne`, `$notContains`, `$gt` and a `$nin` member with `{ owner: 'u1' }` all answer `false` against a text row (no row served) |
| half-face objectql `applyHaving` / `matchesHaving` | already compliant | `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts` passes `query.having` through `normalizeFilterComparandTypes(…, 'having')` |
| 6 driver-memory `checkCondition` | already compliant | behind the engine door (`lowerWhereFilterArray`) |
| 7 driver-mongodb `translateFieldOperators` | already compliant | behind the engine door (`lowerWhereFilterArray`) |

Measured with the spec door directly: `normalizeFilterComparandTypes` answers `INVALID_FILTER` for `{ f: { $ne: { owner: 'u1' } } }`, `$gt`, `$null`, and for a plain-object member under `$in` / `$nin` / `$between`.

## Tests

All readings are on head `1bc51be2`.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core test`: Test Files 243 passed (243), Tests 4552 passed, 27 skipped (4579).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core type-check`: exit 0 (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the three edited test files are in the test program, counted with `--listFilesOnly`).
- Adapters directory alone: Test Files 15 passed (15), Tests 505 passed (505); before the fixture re-spelling, one red: the cyclic plain object under `$icontains` got the nested-relation sentence (see Acceptance notes).
- New pins: a top-level describe at the end of `ValueDataSource.dollarFilterVocabulary.test.ts` (14 per-operator whole-comparand refusals, 3 list-member refusals, 4 object-form vs lowered-AST-form same-sentence pins, CONTROL legs for scalars, `Date`, `{ $field }`, and a class instance with own keys under `$gt` / `$gte` / `$lt` / `$lte`, the class instance as a whole condition, `$empty`'s own sentence, a non-operator key's own sentence), and three AST list-member refusals in `ValueDataSource.astFilterVocabulary.test.ts`. The source exposes no `code` / `status` (refusals are logged sentences), so each pin asserts the row set and the refusal sentence.
- Dogfood battery, on `1bc51be2`, closure built first: `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 482 passed, 3 skipped (485), Tests 4092 passed, 68 skipped (4160), no failure.

<details><summary>Ablations (one per changed behaviour, committed first, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each restored to the HEAD blob with an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

The tests import `../ValueDataSource` by relative path, so the subject resolves to `src/`, not `dist/`; no build leg.

1. `$` arm refusal off (anchor `DOLLAR_COMPARAND_OPERATORS.has(operator)` replaced by `false`, anchor x1 to x0): 21 failed, 161 passed. Red: all 14 whole-comparand cases, all 3 list-member cases, all 4 same-sentence pins.
2. AST list-member judging off (the builder's `listOperator` argument `AST_LIST_COMPARAND_OPERATORS.has(operator)` replaced by `false`): 4 failed, 178 passed. Red: the 3 AST list-member cases and the `$nin member` same-sentence pin.
3. Class-instance routing off (`... > 0 && isPlainObject(condition)) continue;` back to `... > 0) continue;`): 1 failed, 105 passed. Red: the class-instance whole-condition case.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates (derived with dispatch-gates --commands over this diff, 38 families)</summary>

All 38 exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`: "38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 38 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". `pnpm check:type-check-debt` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: its closure build never got a turn on the verify lock while the dogfood battery held it, NOT MEASURED); re-run under the lock it answered exit 0, "0 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number". CI runs the full farm.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, reported to the seat:** `$null` / `$exists` read a non-boolean flag for its truthiness on the value source (`{ f: { $null: { owner: 'u1' } } }` answers the IS NULL rows), and `convertFiltersToAST` lowers it the same way (`['f', 'is_null', true]`), while the spec's door refuses it with `INVALID_FILTER`. Refusing it here alone would split the object form from its lowered form, so a boolean door for both flags (as `$empty` has) belongs on its own card across converter and both arms.
- **Out of scope, noted:** a non-array comparand under `$in` / `$nin` / `$between` that is not an object (`{ f: { $nin: 'x' } }`) still answers no row in silence on the value source; the spec leaves that shape to the engine's list-shape gate, not the comparand door.
- **Fixture re-spelled, not weakened:** `ValueDataSource.nonStringStoredValue.test.ts`'s "a comparand JSON cannot serialise is refused" case used a cyclic PLAIN object under `$icontains`; the new builder refuses that earlier, as a nested relation, so the case now uses a cyclic class instance, which still reaches the text door's comparand description it exists to pin.
- The spec door also refuses a class instance under an ordering operator; this face compares it through `valueOf`, as ruled on the card. Recorded, not re-opened.
- Owed: one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review (narrowing of a published export).

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/core/src/adapters/ValueDataSource.ts`, the new block in `matchesDollarOperator` after the list-member `{ $field }` guard: the operator set it judges (`DOLLAR_COMPARAND_OPERATORS` minus `DOLLAR_FLAG_OPERATORS`).
2. The same file, `loweringConditionRefusal`: the routing line now also routes a non-plain object with own keys.
3. The new top-level describe at the end of `ValueDataSource.dollarFilterVocabulary.test.ts`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/adapters/__tests__/ValueDataSource.dollarFilterVocabulary.test.ts` — expect every case green, including the 14 per-operator whole-comparand refusals, the 3 list-member refusals and the CONTROL legs.
